driver: A count of members seen only through repeated looks by several instruments, each of which either always or never sees a given member, is completed by the chance that at least one of the distinct instruments that looked at a unit found a member, read from how often a second instrument finds a member a first one found; treating every look as an independent chance credits a unit looked at many times by one instrument as fully searched, though it had one chance.
driver_concrete: Each section's potholes per ten lane-miles in March 2027 counts the potholes no camera unit recorded, completed segment by segment as one over the chance that at least one of the distinct installed units that drove the segment found a pothole, the per-unit chance (0.542) read from how often a second unit found a pothole another unit found; a unit records the same potholes on every pass (99.5 per cent of its later days), so a segment its section's patrol pickup drove on seven or more days has had one chance.
stump: The default path completes the potholes no unit recorded by treating every pass over a segment as an independent chance at the rate a pass re-finds a found pothole (64 per cent of unit-days), which changes nothing on segments driven seven or more times, and designates Carrow Point and Elmscourt only; the rural and outer suburban sections one unit drove hide close to half their potholes, and Fenwick Gap, Thistlebank, Holloway Run, Kestrelton and Norvelle clear the line at 7.08 to 8.29.

differentiation.task104: task104 replays a self-adapting scorer at a setting it never ran; here a count of road defects is completed from repeat detections, and the independent chances are the distinct cameras that drove a segment, not its passes.
differentiation.task134: task134's first architecture is a cumulative incidence with competing exits and censoring; here nothing exits and nothing is followed: unseen members are completed from cross-instrument recaptures, each instrument missing the same members on every look.
differentiation.task177: task177 weighs chosen against imposed experiences in later choices; here nothing is chosen: a count is completed from detections whose repeats by one camera carry no new chance of a find.
differentiation.task463: task463 is a spending-weighted price change with stock-up dynamics; here the quantity is a count of potholes completed by the number of distinct cameras that drove each segment.
differentiation.task501: task501 is the dominant eigenvalue of a who-passes-to-whom matrix; here a count is completed by the chance of at least one find across the distinct cameras that drove a segment.
differentiation.task70: task70 constructs per-record dates from an event log under a class cut; here the decisive construction is how many independent looks each segment had, the distinct cameras, read against the passes the telematics log lists.
differentiation.task236: task236 reads a capture rate against an independent fixed-protocol source after a capture change; here no protocol changes and no outside source exists: a second camera is the independent look and a repeat pass by the same camera is not.
differentiation.task453: task453's first architecture adjusts a seasonal pattern across a documented placement change; here the decisive step completes undetected defects by distinct-instrument occasions.
differentiation.task471: task471's census and survey miss the same members of one hard-to-count group, a dependence across units fixed by a demographic benchmark; here each camera misses its own independent set of potholes on every pass, a dependence within one instrument, fixed inside the record by counting distinct cameras as the occasions and reading their find rate from cross-camera recaptures.
differentiation.task470: task470's transponder network never records some aircraft at all, so the missing activity is rebuilt from a register of units; here every pothole is visible to some cameras and not to others, independently, and the unseen are completed from the cameras' own cross-recaptures.
differentiation.task462: task462 weights each plume by one over a size-dependent detection probability fitted on blind releases; here detection does not depend on the defect and no trials exist: the per-camera find rate is read from cross-camera recaptures, and the decisive move is that repeat passes by one camera add no chance.
differentiation.task473: task473 completes untested drivers by the arrest catch rate at each positive's own BAC band, measured where everyone is tested; here there is no complete-observation subset and no band: the unseen are completed by the number of distinct cameras each segment had.
differentiation.task264: task264 weights sampled persons by the inverse of their visit multiplicity across sites; here the repeated looks are one camera's passes over one segment, and the estimand is the members no look found, not the distinct members among those seen.
differentiation.task239: task239 estimates how strongly each component's group-level part goes with a shared factor from the few members who answered; here the decisive unit is the capture occasion, a camera rather than a pass, in completing a count of unseen defects.
differentiation.task48: task48's re-root recovers a population invisible at a monitor's grain by aggregating transactions to a two-sided pair grain; here nothing is regrouped to find a population: passes are regrouped by camera to count the independent chances a segment's defects had.
differentiation.task120: task120's first architecture builds a unit from two links no file stores, for percentile cuts; here the unit is the detection occasion, and it completes a count of unseen defects.
differentiation.task269: task269 works each rider's wait over only the departures serving the rider's destination; here nothing waits: the occasions that could find a defect are the distinct cameras, not the passes, and they complete a count.
differentiation.task181: task181 locates losses of separation by a geometric condition (one aircraft crossing another's level) to forecast each sector; here nothing is located by geometry: the unseen potholes are completed from how many distinct cameras drove each segment.
differentiation.task229: task229 times two stations' peak releases against a flow window; here no schedule exists: a count of potholes is completed from cross-camera recaptures, the passes of one camera adding no chance.
differentiation.task98: task98 counts dwellings under a points cap as permits end; here no record lapses and no cap applies: the decisive step completes defects no camera recorded, counting cameras rather than passes as the looks.
differentiation.task126: task126 reads which continuity edges are re-examinations against continuing applications; here no edge is classified: the grains are a segment's passes and its distinct cameras, and only the second are independent chances of a find.
differentiation.task34: task34 separates populations by a fitted rent structure and an admissibility test; here nothing is fitted to separate members: every pothole is one population, and the unseen part of it is completed by distinct-camera recapture.
differentiation.task49: task49 floors each award's unpaid amount at zero per award; here nothing is floored or netted: the decisive grain is the capture occasion, a camera, in completing a count of unseen defects.
